name: Meteoric Rise
author: 16lord
description: Hold to the last slope at 23.8% to go above the cube portal between the slope the saw as the mini ship. Fall down from the ceiling shortly after at 24.7% and then do a blind straightfly between the invisible saws at 26.0% to fall to the floor and stay there. Start holding at 64.0% and then release a bit early to touch the UFO portal without dying to the saws right after. Play the rest of the level normally from there.
